main.description: P10.2b critique-side aggregator. Overlays the Hume image-feature `emotionAlignment` score onto each render's LLM axes (when target_mood + B2 are available), computes the aggregate mean per render, and selects the highest-scoring render. Tolerant to renders with full `critique.axes`, with only `score`, or with neither (falls back to `fallback_score`). ADR-2605082000 §2 — kind='mcp_tool'. SSoT: lg_mangaka.tools:tool_aggregate_critique.

renders.description: Output of com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.tools.renderKeyframes (optionally already carrying a `critique.axes` from an upstream vision LLM).

targetMood.description: Panel mood (`plan.mood`) used by Hume to score `emotionAlignment` against the rendered PNG's visual features. Hume overlay is skipped when this is null.

fallbackScore.description: Score assigned to renders without LLM axes. Default 0.6. Keeps the refinement-loop predicate stable when the vision LLM is unavailable.

renders.description: Same shape as input, but with `score` set and (when axes were present or Hume fired) a `critique.{axes, notes, score, humeEvidence}` block.

selected.description: The single render with the highest aggregate score.

score.description: Selected render's aggregate score, fed into the conditional refinement edge.
